2164 │   The rational Hochschild–Serre sequence for $U lt.tri K$ collapses to finite quotient invariants: positive cohomology of the finite group $K \/ U$ vanishes by averaging in $bb(Q)_p$. Here $"Lie" \( K \)$ is the Lie algebra of a $"GL"_n$-form, with $n = 2$ or $3$. The exterior calculation and triviality of its adjoint action are given by #cite(label("BSSW")) Lemma 3.8.2. They give generators in degrees $1 \, 3 \, dots.h \, 2 n - 1$, without choosing explicit cocycles for all of them. Thus the finite quotient fixes the cohomology, and in particular the low-degree dimensions are $1 \, 0 \, 1$ in degrees $1 \, 2 \, 3$.
